External merge sort

page
a rack section on its back: 16 values, ordered left to right and top to bottom; the blue bar shows the key
R
the table on disk, 36 pages; pass 0 reads each page once
bench
main memory: room for 4 pages, no more
run
a sorted temporary file; deleted once it is merged
cable
how a page travels between disk and memory: one cable per run read, one to the run written
heap
the merge's heap: one value per input run, the smallest at the root; colours tell the inputs apart
levels
input above, output below: the bench moves down one level per pass
bill
3 passes read 36 pages each; the first two write 36 each, the last one streams: 108 + 72 = 180

Slide set 09b, External Sorting; the runs and the merge groups are those of ExternalMergeSort in system/query_processing/sorting.py (memory 64 values, fan-in 3).
